identity.title: Unveiling a Population of Strong Galaxy─Galaxy Lensed, Faint Dusty Star-forming Galaxies

paper_type_evidence.quote: Utilizing the deepest SCUBA-2 submillimeter survey, STUDIES, in both the COSMOS and the UDS fields, together with a red JWST color selection method, we discover a population of 13 strong galaxy-galaxy lensed faint dusty galaxies.
The ALMA imaging data were obtained from the ALMA Science Archive.
